prompt_text: I need a personal injury lawyer in Houston after a car wreck. Which specific law firms should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Houston for a car wreck?
answer_verbatim:
I can recommend several Houston-area personal injury firms you should consider calling after a car wreck — and why each might be a good fit. If you want, I can also look up phone numbers and local office locations once you tell me your ZIP code.

Recommended firms to call (and why)

1. Buzbee Law (Tony Buzbee)
   - Why: High‑profile Houston trial lawyer known for taking catastrophic and high‑value car wreck cases to trial; aggressive strategy against big insurers.

2. Arnold & Itkin LLP
   - Why: Houston‑based plaintiffs’ trial firm with a strong track record in serious injury and wrongful‑death cases; experienced trial teams and resources for complex liability disputes.

3. Mark Lanier Law Firm
   - Why: Nationally recognized trial lawyers with large verdicts and experience handling catastrophic injuries and complex medical/insurance issues.

4. Morgan & Morgan (Houston office)
   - Why: One of the largest plaintiff firms in the country with local presence and resources to handle high-volume and complex auto cases; contingency fee structure and extensive support staff.

5. Jim Adler — “The Texas Hammer”
   - Why: Longstanding Texas personal injury practice focused on motor vehicle collisions; local name recognition and lots of experience with insurance companies.

6. Provost Umphrey (Houston)
   - Why: Regional firm with strong trial experience in catastrophic personal injury and wrongful death; good for cases that may require litigation against corporate or commercial defendants.

How to choose which to call first
- Severity & complexity: For catastrophic injuries, call firms known for big‑case litigation (Buzbee, Arnold & Itkin, Mark Lanier). For moderate injuries or faster resolution, a large firm like Morgan & Morgan or an experienced local firm might be appropriate.
- Trial experience: If the insurer is likely to fight, prefer a firm with a proven trial record.
- Contingency & costs: Most PI firms work on contingency, but ask about medical liens, case costs, and whether they advance expenses.
- Fit & communication: Call 2–3 firms to compare how they assess your case, responsiveness, and whether you feel comfortable with the attorney/team.

Questions to ask when you call
- Do you handle car wreck cases in Houston? How many similar cases have you taken to trial?
- Who will handle my case (attorney/team)? Will I deal with the attorney directly?
- Do you work on contingency? What percentage and what expenses would I be responsible for?
- Do you handle medical liens and coordinate medical care for clients?
- What is your initial assessment and likely timeline for my case?

What to have ready for the initial call
- Date/time/location of crash
- Photos of the scene and vehicle damage (if any)
- Police report number (if available)
- Brief summary of injuries and medical care so far
- Names/insurance info of other drivers and witnesses

If you want, tell me:
- Your ZIP code (so I can find nearby offices), and
- A short description of your injuries and the crash (severity, fault dispute, whether police/ambulance were present),

and I’ll pull phone numbers, office locations, and any relevant lawyer profiles or client‑review summaries.
